title: Estée Lauder Raises FY 2027 Outlook as Q1 Sales Rise to $3.7B, Driven by Fragrance Growth
summary: The beauty giant saw growth across key categories like skin care and fragrance, with strong performances from brands including La Mer, Tom Ford and Jo Malone London.
